[***Population Health Metrics***]{.journal} · 2024

\[[Article](https://doi.org/10.1186/s12963-024-00332-2)\] · \[[Replication kit](https://osf.io/fj3tc/)\]

## \> *We introduce a novel graphical representation that combines national mortality rates with social inequalities, considering both absolute and relative measures. Age-specific analyses reveal for Germany some worrying regional divergence trends at ages 35-74 in recent years.*
